title: Worker image render mode: auritus render writes speech.wav + speech.json to S3
description: A Batch entry point that doesn't use the Auritus API. The request JSON (text, voice, speed, seed, output bucket and prefix) comes from env or S3. It runs `auritus.synthesize` and writes `<prefix>/speech.wav` plus `<prefix>/speech.json` (sample_rate, duration, segments, provenance, request_key). On failure it writes `<prefix>/error.json` and exits non-zero. Specs use the fake backend and a local folder standing in for the bucket. Needs A5 (the worker image uses the auritus package).

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #70: `auritus.render` plus the entrypoint dispatch (AURITUS_MODE=render). 4 behave scenarios (red without the module, green with it), moto S3 tests, and a real Kokoro render verified. The request contract that SpeechRenderer (auritus-c9d582) will submit is `AURITUS_RENDER_REQUEST={text, voice, speed?, seed?, output}`, plus `AURITUS_ALLOWED_BACKENDS` and `AURITUS_TTS_BACKEND`. Output is speech.wav and speech.json, or error.json.
